scope: Bounded read-only feasibility review of SOURCE-CONVERSION-DRAFT-R2 retained lightweight input and validator dependencies. No production, test, Vault, Git, network, or external-process mutation.

public_leaf.note: The public leaf remains in the existing formal-source command group; this review does not authorize a new source command group.

rules: The record directory name is a 64-character lowercase hex record ID.
The record directory has no extra files or directories.
All JSON is persisted canonical JSON and every file is a regular, non-hardlinked file.
Manifest, identity, wrapper, document, context, evidence, source snapshot, and content hashes must agree.
Every base_record_id and candidate_record_id ancestry edge is recursively validated.
The job directory has no extra files or directories.
Accepted batches and merge steps form the complete contiguous chain.
completion.json binds the actual final record and merge hash.
validate_job_provenance validates persisted workspace_id structurally but does not compare it with the mirror path.
Both files and their parent directory are regular, non-symlink, non-hardlinked paths.
source.json paper_id and document.path bind the selected lightweight SHA-256 paper ID and relative source.md path.
Page anchors, intervals, Markdown hash, source.json hash, and every derived chunk are recomputed from the captured bytes.
_load_paper metadata_path is absolute in its returned object but is unused by this validation path; conversion must not forward it as authority.

validator_dependency_map.index_requirement: No .light-index tree is required for current_head_record_id, record bundle validation, provenance validation, or _record_source_status. Search, export, and current-plan binding are different paths.

retained_input_policy.mode: complete .light-knowledge tree plus the selected paper source.md/source.json and conversion metadata/authority inputs
checks: Retain every entry in the complete .light-knowledge tree, including unrelated records and jobs selected by the root policy.
Materialize the generated mirror from the one retained byte set under a real .work path; do not use symlinks or hardlinks.
Verify exact bytes, file identities, complete sets, and named lineages against the original retained tree before and after every success or exception path.
Do not read the original lightweight workspace after capture and do not mutate, rebuild, or reindex the mirror during conversion.
Keep the original retained tree and generated mirror alive for the full operation.

allowed_readonly_calls: the extracted existing source-publication prepare body using the same retained Vault session
forbidden_or_out_of_scope_calls: import/finalize/reindex/search/export routes that require a live index or workspace identity
global monkeypatching or a process-global reader override
original PDF reads or PDF copying

coherent_points: The public leaf is formal-source convert and reuses the existing source-publication inspection leaf.
The formal canonical paper ID remains distinct from the lightweight SHA-256 paper ID.
The declared original_pdf_sha256 remains metadata provenance and is not freshly read or upgraded.
collect_source_state with require_rendered=False derives complete pages and both head registries from one retained Vault snapshot, avoiding duplicate compiler assembly.
Explicit proposed_at and valid published_at values remain required; the current date is not a fallback.
Existing aliases, source associations, observation bytes, historical ledger snapshots, and event bytes remain subject to existing preservation rules.
conditions_before_implementation_accepta: Prove the complete-tree retained session and generated mirror use only the captured byte set and retain both original and mirror for all exits.
Prove the implementation never enters workspace-id-bound resumable paths.
Prove source observation/raw byte equality and exact locator spans before assembling the overlay.
Keep light paper_id, formal paper_id, and declared original PDF hash as separate fields throughout conversion.
